renderedScreens.instruction: Implement the Superpowers invocation policy in the AGENTS repository workflow. Before each new Superpowers skill or command invocation, reproduce the previously agreed twelve-row activity-to-skill mapping verbatim, identify the applicable skill, load its instructions, and apply them. Read applicable AGENTS.md and README first; respect workspace permissions. Return the implementation status as {$implementationStatus}.
